text:
Zara Khan: Heads-up: candidate Ivo Novak (Backend SWE) in CET requested an official visa invitation letter for a possible onsite loop. Wants interviews only between 09:00-13:00 CET.
Owen Li: Visa letter OK but needs hiring manager sign-off and headcount code. Mina, do we have the code?
Mina Patel: Hiring manager approved headcount HR-2026-84. I'll prepare the visa invitation draft. Sam, please confirm candidate passport name & preferred pickup for the loaner (if needed).
Sam (Recruiter): Candidate provided passport name and DOB in secure note. Prefers not to take a loaner; will use personal machine but does need a company email alias for calendaring. Also can only do Tue/Thu mornings CET.
Zara Khan: Great, that simplifies shipping. Draft the invitation letter and mark "no financial guarantee" per policy. Add event notes about interview window 09:00-13:00 CET.
Mina Patel: Draft ready. Sending to hiring manager for signature. Also adding a short lines about travel reimbursement policy and contact person at HR Ops.
HR Ops: Received draft. Signed and returned as PDF. Visa letter uploaded to candidate file. Reminder: candidate should receive PDF and a secure link, not attach in public threads.
Logistics Bot: Reminder: If candidate later requests loaner, 5 business days lead time for EU shipments. Internal link: https://redwood/internal/loaner-request.
Owen Li: Scheduling note: Panel is mostly PST folks. 09:00 CET = 00:00 PST. That's painful. Can we do hybrid: two live interviews at 09:30 CET and one async recorded design?
Zara Khan: Yes, propose Tue 2026-10-12 09:30 CET (core live interviews), recorded design for one interviewer. Sam, confirm with candidate.
Sam (Recruiter): Candidate confirmed Tue 2026-10-12 09:30 CET and agreed to recorded design for one interviewer. Also requested an alias email (ivo.novak@redwood.com) for invites.
Mina Patel: Alias created and invites sent. Added note: "visa letter attached to candidate secure portal" and troubleshooting checklist: `-- test calendar invite 24h prior -- verify timezone display -- if any panelist can't do 00:00 PST, use recorded option`.
Owen Li: Panel volunteers: Owen (can do 00:00 PST), Priya (declined), Jules (can do if compensated). Not ideal but covered.
Zara Khan: Thanks. Post-interview: HR Ops will send travel reimbursement paperwork if candidate requests onsite. Sam, please capture candidate experience notes.
Sam (Recruiter): Will do. Candidate confirmed receipt: "Got the visa letter, thanks. Confirming Tue 09:30 CET." :white_check_mark:
Zara Khan: Closing the loop. I'll log this thread to candidate record and HR Ops tracker. Thanks team.
